ratings.note: Every booking; residents must remember slot/vehicle for the gate. One below suggestion: confirm step shows details just before and an SMS reminder arrives the evening before.
Small memory load on every booking; recoverable on the confirm step.
Same symptom as B-011 (unmeasured visual estimate); 'Few left' tag hard to read on days with few-left slots.
Only the first count on load is missed by screen readers; the text is still in the page to read.
Primary car group sees an irrelevant permit field; hesitation rather than a block (visible in vehicle screenshot).
A double tap, invited by the missing pending state, silently cancels the booking; resident can be turned away at the gate.
No feedback for 1.5 s on the only commit action of every booking, and it directly provokes the B-006 double tap.
Unannounced 5-minute hold; interrupted residents lose the scarce slot. Booking a few times a year means it is not learned.
Same issue as B-016: hold limit never stated; slot lost after the whole form is filled.
Recovery link 'Change slot' sits right under the alert and details are kept; harder for screen-reader users.
Same issue as B-016/B-012: no indication of the limited hold.
Forced-colours users only; the day caption below compensates and the state is exposed programmatically.
Wrong-day caption over an empty grid for about 1 s on every day change; may read as no slots.
Only residents amending waste at confirm; workaround via Change vehicle or Back.
0.9 s blank grid with no loading cue on every day change; dead Next rarely hit in that window.
False reference shown as Booked when the session is gone (e.g. reopened at the gate). One below suggestion: needs a reopened/new-tab path and the real reference was shown earlier.
Van/trailer residents without a permit get no route to apply, mid-booking on a phone. One above suggestion: a core task group is left with a dead end.
About 3:1 for small bold text in both themes; older residents in dark mode may miss the scarcity cue. Times themselves stay legible.
Van/trailer permit error found only after the whole form, unlinked, field on another page.
Today is the default day and same-day booking is common; past slots look free and are rejected only at the end.

Heading 'Booked' plus gate instructions on a cancelled booking can send a resident to be turned away. One below suggestion: the red 'Status: cancelled' line sits directly under the reference (screenshot), so most sighted users see it.
Permit field with no vehicle chosen and no 'vans and trailers only' label; confusion for the car majority, not a block.
Few-left slots pulled out of time order above Morning on every day view (screenshot); slower scanning, misreading day part, mismatch with screen-reader order.
Changing the slot silently resets to Today, risking a wrong-day booking. One below suggestion: the pressed Today button, day caption and confirm Day row give chances to catch it.
Core task 2 has no online route; weekday-only phone line while the centre is open at weekends.
No sign of change mode; uncertainty whether details are kept. The wrong-day risk is rated in B-024.
Same issue as B-010: permit validated only at the final step, unlinked.
Permit lead time hidden behind an unlabelled icon; mainly first-time van users. Opening-days panel states that a permit is needed.
Same issue as B-019: change/cancel only by weekday phone.
Every phone booking: Next far below the chosen slot; learned after one use.
